candidate: Puerto Rican Bullfinch annual surveyed re-detection on the 40-point Luquillo Forest Dynamics Plot bird grid, 1998-2021

focal_taxon.selection_rule: fixed from the independent BirdsCaribbean Endemic & Threatened Species Working Group example of a Puerto Rico endemic forest/woodland bird, before Luquillo Dataset 23 response access; not selected from Dataset 23 counts or EOG results

scientific_anchor.published_design: 40 permanently located LFDP point-count sites; 10-minute counts; bird observations recorded within <=25 m and >25 m; official visitor guide describes forty locations on a 60 m x 60 m grid
scientific_anchor.endpoint: annual site-level recorded detection/re-detection using the <=25 m series; not latent occupancy or historical truth

temporal_design.reason_for_start: 1997 is independently documented as an incomplete census with only 15 sites; 1998 start is effort-defined before focal response access

future_boundary.paired_endpoint: same frozen strong learner and conventional features in both arms; augmented arm adds only unchanged Layer B
